prompt:
Image 1 is the exact character: a chibi young boy knight with messy light-brown hair with an ahoge, brown eyes, a tattered olive-green cape, a steel breastplate and steel arm and leg armour over brown leather, holding a long steel longsword in his right hand. Keep his identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact sword design from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1. Do NOT mirror him: the sword stays in the same hand as in Image 1 (both hands on the hilt only where the pose says so), and the sword is always ONE whole rigid blade.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of him drawing the longsword with both hands up and behind his rear shoulder, the blade pointing back over his shoulder, hips turned away from the enemy, knees bent, loading a big swing. A clear, readable, powerful silhouette for a small phone screen; the body commits to the action (feet, hips and shoulders), not only the arm. Eyes open.

Background: 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Centered, the whole character and the whole sword fully inside the image with a wide magenta margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No motion blur, slash trail, glow, wind, sparks, particles, speed lines, text or labels.

precheck.summary: Background is flat #FF00FF with no gradient or shadow, and the full figure and sword sit inside the frame with margin.
